name: Import Circuit Image into KiCad
description: Turn a photo, screenshot, scan, or hand-drawn sketch of a circuit into an editable KiCad schematic.
description_full: Pick a circuit image (PNG/JPG/WebP) and this plugin converts it into an editable .kicad_sch schematic using S2S (sketch-to-schematic). The generated schematic opens in KiCad; you can further edit, run ERC, and simulate the circuit online at s2s.diy. Leads with the import task — no need to know S2S beforehand.
